title: Hive Inspection Application Task Board
originalRequest: Establish a comprehensive tracking system for the beekeeping app development project, covering core inspections, offline telemetry synchronization, and localized testing.
latestMessage: Establish a comprehensive tracking system for the beekeeping app development project, covering core inspections, offline telemetry synchronization, and localized testing.

steps.title: Initialize local database schema for inspections
steps.instruction: Design and apply the SQLite database schema to store hive ID, inspection timestamp, temper level, queen sighted boolean, brood pattern rating, and honey super status.
steps.acceptance: The database initializes without errors and allows CRUD operations on inspection records.
steps.result: Database migration script 001_init_inspections.sql created and successfully tested against mock datasets. Read and write operations verified on local emulator.

steps.title: Implement offline-first synchronization protocol
steps.instruction: Develop a synchronization service that queues hive inspection records locally when there is no network connectivity, and pushes them to the central backend once a connection is detected.
steps.acceptance: Inspections taken offline are correctly uploaded sequentially without data loss when network is restored.
steps.result: Offline queue mechanics established using local IndexedDB storage. Currently designing the conflict resolution strategy for concurrent updates to the same hive state. Progress is ongoing.

steps.title: Integrate third-party hive scale weight telemetry
steps.instruction: Connect to the API of external Bluetooth-enabled hive scales to pull daily weight trends during an inspection.
steps.acceptance: The app parses weight data payloads and populates the inspection log with current hive mass.
steps.result: Blocked after two attempts. Attempt 1 failed due to undocumented authentication protocols on the scale manufacturer sandbox. Attempt 2 failed because the sandbox API returned 503 errors repeatedly. Awaiting updated vendor documentation and stable API access keys.

steps.title: Implement computer vision queen bee detection
steps.instruction: Embed a lightweight TensorFlow Lite model to analyze uploaded frame images and highlight the queen bee location.
steps.acceptance: Model successfully processes 640x640 images within under 500ms on test devices and outputs bounding boxes.
steps.result: Blocked after two attempts. Attempt 1: The pre-compiled model file size exceeded the maximum Android assets package size limit. Attempt 2: Attempted post-training quantization, but accuracy dropped below the acceptable 80 percent threshold. Need guidance on hardware-acceleration requirements or permission to use a cloud-based classification endpoint.

steps.title: Integrate audio spectrum analysis for swarm forecasting
steps.instruction: Process short audio recordings from inside the hive to detect specific acoustic frequencies associated with swarming behavior.
steps.acceptance: Fast Fourier Transform runs on the audio recording, outputs frequency spikes, and triggers a warning UI indicator if threshold is breached.
steps.result: Blocked after two attempts. Attempt 1: The iOS microphone capture APIs failed to initialize within the background service runner. Attempt 2: High noise interference from wind in mock outdoor audio rendered the thresholding algorithm ineffective. Blocking task pending noise-filtering library implementation.

steps.title: Generate PDF inspection summary export
steps.instruction: Build a report generation service to compile historical hive metrics, treatment logs, and queen sighting notes into a shareable PDF.
steps.acceptance: Generates a clean multi-page PDF output matching the design mockups, accessible locally in the device downloads folder.

steps.title: Integrate meteorological data service
steps.instruction: Query local weather APIs using the hive's GPS coordinates to capture temperature, humidity, and barometric pressure at the exact time of inspection.
steps.acceptance: Inspections automatically record wind speed and ambient temperature from the external API without manual input.

steps.title: Build analytics dashboard for hive telemetry trends
steps.instruction: Create time-series visualizations showing weight fluctuations, internal temperature, and humidity levels over weekly and monthly intervals.
steps.acceptance: Dashboard renders responsive charts using local storage history, supporting filter by hive ID and date range.

steps.title: Design interactive frame-by-frame colony population estimator
steps.instruction: Implement an interface allowing users to tap on a virtual representation of hive frames to quickly record coverage percentages of brood, honey, pollen, and empty space.
steps.acceptance: Saves a complete 10-frame grid mapping to the database, ensuring totals do not exceed physical capacity.

steps.title: Configure Varroa mite treatment scheduler
steps.instruction: Implement a scheduling system that triggers local push notifications when a hive's mite threshold exceeds critical limits, prompt for treatment follow-ups.
steps.acceptance: Schedules notification events in the OS daemon based on calculated treatment cycles.

steps.title: Establish automated integration tests for synchronization
steps.instruction: Write end-to-end integration tests mimicking offline-to-online transitions with simulated network packet loss.
steps.acceptance: Tests verify that transaction ordering is strictly preserved and duplicate records are safely discarded.
